messages:
maria_sales: Hi all — ACME wants a quick POC next week. They need a billing org/project, $3k spend cap, 30 days of free credits, and scoped API keys that expire after the POC. Also asked about a Dedicated pool for sustained throughput and a VPC option. Can we do all that low-touch?

sam_engineering: Yup we can. Workflow we usually follow: create billing org -> create project for the POC -> attach a spend cap (spendshield) -> issue an ephemeral API key scoped to that project. Dedicated pool or VPC are separate requests (infra provisioning).

maria_sales: Perfect. Do we have an example ephemeral key command I can give them? They prefer simple curl snippets.

kevin_se: Share this snippet: 
```
# create ephemeral key via admin API (example)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/keys/ephemeral \  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \  -d '{"project_id":"proj-acme-poc","ttl_seconds":2592000,"scopes":["inference:generate"]}'
```
Key will be scoped to proj-acme-poc and auto-expire in 30d. Mentioned caveat: ephemeral keys cannot be used to change org-level billing settings.

yuki_infra: For the Dedicated pool: we need a Capacity Request in the infra tracker. I'll need expected RPS, model family, token/sec estimates, and preferred region. We can short-circuit for a POC with "burst" dedicated if finance approves. For VPC/private, security will want a questionnaire answered and a short network diagram.

maria_sales: ACME's initial ask: 100 req/s, using t5-large-ish model (open), region us-west-2. They prefer VPC but can live without it for the first week. I'll collect network diagram if needed.

oliver_finops: On spend cap: we can attach a hard spendshield of $3,000 to the billing project. That will freeze requests once reached. Note: spendshield is enforced per billing project, not per API key. I'll provision credits: 30 days, up to $2,000 in free credits — the remainder of $1,000 is a cap they need to cover or we keep at hard cap. Do we want to auto-charge or require PO?

maria_sales: For POC, sales prefer to cover first $2k as promotional credits; customer signs a trial T&C. If they go past $3k, we block. No auto-charge.

oliver_finops: OK I can do credits + hard cap. I need customer billing contact and company legal name.

maria_sales: I'll send contact: emma@acme.com and ACME Corp (US).

sam_engineering: For onboarding steps I recommend: 1) Create billing org + proj (oliver) 2) Provision credits + attach spendshield (oliver) 3) Infra ticket for Dedicated/burst (yuki) 4) Create ephemeral key and share with ACME (kevin) 5) Provide sample curl + SDK snippet and a small prompt set for quality smoke tests (me).

provision-bot: Ticket created — infra/1234: "ACME POC request: burst dedicated + optional VPC" assigned to yuki_infra. ETA: 48h for initial capacity check.

kevin_se: One more note on key scoping: if they want multiple developer keys, we can create project-level API keys tied to specific roles (read-only / inference-only). Ephemeral tokens are best for security.

maria_sales: Sweet. Action items: Oliver to provision credits + spendshield; Yuki to triage infra ticket; Kevin/Sam to produce ephemeral key snippet and quickstart. I'll update ACME and aim to start Monday. Thanks :pray: 

provision-bot: finance/789: "ACME credit grant $2000 + spendshield $3000" — queued for manual approval by oliver_finops.
